free_tier.stated: No total storage cap on free accounts; 10 MB per file on free (20 MB per Discord's own File Attachments FAQ), 50 MB Nitro Basic, 1 GB Nitro; attachments upload up to 500 MiB per file via the cloud-upload endpoint before the message-time limit applies
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Free and CDN-served; every attachment URL is signed with `ex`/`is`/`hm` params, so links are time-limited but re-mintable via the API at zero cost

tooling: forscht/ddrive (533 stars, MIT, active 4.x line, Docker image, OpenAPI 3.1 REST front end, Postgres metadata, webhook-based to avoid rate limits) - explicitly 'unlimited file size and unlimited storage'; also theseyan/distore, iShibi/discord-drive
chaining: Per-file cap x shard count is irrelevant because ddrive splits into 24 MB chunks. Author reports 'tested with storing 4000 GB of data on single discord channel'. Several free Discord accounts, servers and channels each carry a separate allowance, and a bot token can span many channels.
limits_note: 24 MB chunk size in ddrive; 500 MiB per-file ceiling on the cloud-upload path; aggressive per-channel message and upload rate limits (ddrive moves to webhooks specifically to route around them); attachment URLs expire (hex `ex` timestamp) and must be re-fetched

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Highest operational risk of the set: Discord rate-limits uploads hard, CDN URLs expire, and the reference demo (ddrive.forscht.dev) is currently down (HTTP 522), so the wrapper is battle-tested but its hosted instance is not.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

'upload up a file up to 500 MiB directly to Google Cloud'; reference.mdx documents `ex` as 'Hex timestamp indicating when an attachment CDN URL will expire'
